checks.reason: The actual managed direct-reader fixture first receives an HTTP body through the credential-paired caller transport, then replaces ReaderLoaded and publishes Ready. The retained client must refuse its next request and the server must observe exactly one request. This covers direct-reader transport replacement, not a live Cloud service.
